# Benoît Hervier, Freelance Lead Developer & Software Architect

> Benoît Hervier is a freelance senior software engineer and software architect based in France (SIRET 520 039 132 00037), specializing in Go (Golang), Python and C/C++ on Linux. He designs and builds reliable systems across a wide spectrum: 24/7 real-time media capture and AI analytics platforms (speech-to-text, OCR, audio fingerprinting, vector search), CE-certified Class IIa embedded medical devices, and scalable backend services. Available for freelance missions, consulting and contract work. Contact: b@rvier.fr.

## Services

- Software architecture and technical leadership for backend, media and AI platforms
- Design and development of Go and Python services (APIs, workers, orchestrators)
- Applied AI integration: speech-to-text at scale, OCR fine-tuning, LLM enrichment pipelines, vector search

- Audits, rescue missions and performance optimization of existing systems
